title: Frontmatter classification for recovered evidence docs

consequences: No accepted contract is changed and no OQ is closed: the Input and Pointer Contract stays Draft/candidate, the new lifecycle wording uses no RFC-2119 keywords to match corpus vocabulary, and the product fix plus hermetic fcitx-shaped fixtures stay owned by the bitty repository (CTX-0783). The gap-analysis row returns to 'shipped' only when bitty#1449 closes with ordering fixtures green; that re-verification must touch all three documents in one change. specifications/text-rendering-rfc.md TXT-10/TXT-11 still disagree on the bounds and need a text-RFC-owner follow-up. specifications/README.md index cell was corrected because it had become false.
context: bitty#1449 (P1) reports a synthetic trailing space after an fcitx composition commit. Root evidence at bitty 679f12f: the composition guard in crates/bitty-runtime/src/runtime/input.rs:548 and :682 is keyed on overlay presence (ime_preedit.is_some()), and the empty Preedit that winit's Ime::Commit contract sends before Commit clears that overlay, so the composition is already closed when the commit-triggering key is processed. The corpus also disagreed with itself: text-compatibility.md carried the retired draft's 256-scalar/256-byte bounds while input-pointer-rfc.md and the shipped code used 128/256/1024, and the terminal-feature-gap-analysis.md row still claimed 'shipped'.
decision_body: State the composition lifecycle, the preedit-to-commit ordering rule, the verbatim-commit guarantee, and the focus-loss/cancel table once in specifications/input-pointer-rfc.md (the input contract, unchanged draft status); have text-compatibility.md and terminal-feature-gap-analysis.md link to it and record only the text-domain and shipped-versus-missing halves; align the text-domain bounds to the shipped 128/256/1024 values; downgrade the gap-analysis IME row from 'shipped' to 'partial' with the open defect and the evidence that the existing headless fixture never exercises the commit-key ordering.
title: IME commit contract lives in the Input and Pointer Contract; docs state the rule and record bitty#1449 as unmet
